gates.title: Canonical path safety
gates.required_behavior: Equivalent path aliases and normalized duplicates are rejected or stored consistently; a failed candidate never poisons the store.
gates.remaining_boundary: Local POSIX path/capture tests; macOS case-insensitive filesystem execution is not certified.

gates.title: Preserve original protections
gates.required_behavior: Original relevant rollback, fencing, stale draft, artifact integrity and export protections remain passing; intentional interface changes have reviewed equivalents.
gates.remaining_boundary: Original audited v1 source and 48-test suite were not available; compatibility equivalence is unproven.

gates.title: Intent revision authority
gates.required_behavior: Attempt unauthorized objective/mission/source changes with unchanged revision; reject and preserve prior obligations.
gates.remaining_boundary: Authority-revision tests cover this runtime API, not hidden provider state or same-UID administrator tampering.

gates.title: Requirement preservation
gates.required_behavior: Removing, cancelling or superseding a live requirement requires a valid decision; descendants remain traceable.
gates.remaining_boundary: Explicit requirement preservation/disposition is tested; legacy requirement migration is not.

gates.title: Reopen scope
gates.required_behavior: Reusing an unrelated/expired decision cannot authorize later accepted-task changes.
gates.remaining_boundary: Scoped, expiring, consumed decisions are tested through this runtime.

gates.title: Typed domain records
gates.required_behavior: Booleans/nulls/arbitrary strings in domain object lists and invalid references are rejected.
gates.remaining_boundary: Strict domain/RPC validation is tested for supplied public commands.

gates.title: Completion gate consistency
gates.required_behavior: A task requiring a failed/missing integration or unexecuted verifier cannot become accepted completion.
gates.remaining_boundary: Derived acceptance rejects missing/failed verification; actual user application deployment is not tested.

gates.title: Evidence candidate binding
gates.required_behavior: Change tested code, contract, config or dependency; historical PASS survives but cannot silently prove new candidate.
gates.remaining_boundary: Source/contract/repository/oracle binding is tested locally; external services are not reproducible candidate inputs.

gates.title: Admission dependencies
gates.required_behavior: Execution effects cannot start while required dependency is unmet; explicitly permitted planning remains possible.
gates.remaining_boundary: Task dependency admission is exercised in this runtime.

gates.title: Context mandatory coverage
gates.required_behavior: Required intent, ADR, layout, contract, unresolved effects and evidence pointers arrive in scoped context; missing coverage blocks affected action.
gates.remaining_boundary: Mandatory source/intent/obligation inclusion and budget failure are tested; actual model ingestion is not observable.

gates.title: Superseded-memory adversary
gates.required_behavior: Inject a highly similar old layout/ADR memory; current approved source remains controlling and old source stays labeled historical.
gates.remaining_boundary: Untrusted memory cannot replace approved sources; semantic retrieval/provider injection is not implemented.

gates.title: Forced context reset
gates.required_behavior: Delete session context after durable task admission; fresh agent resumes correct task, source versions and exact obligations without owner re-brief.
gates.remaining_boundary: Real daemon reset with cold manual-client continuation; not actual model-session or compaction certification.

gates.title: Effect write-ahead
gates.required_behavior: Kill executor before/after dispatch and before receipt; every effect has durable intent and uncertain results reconcile without blind replay.
gates.remaining_boundary: Several real/deterministic crash boundaries exercised; not physical power loss or every external adapter.

gates.title: Command idempotency
gates.required_behavior: Duplicate request with same ID/hash returns prior result; same ID/different payload is rejected.
gates.remaining_boundary: Transactional per-actor request ID and exact-payload deduplication are tested.

gates.title: Functional vertical slice
gates.required_behavior: Real user action reaches actual application behavior and durable store, persists over reload/restart and is visible to successor.
gates.remaining_boundary: Real fixture application and durable SQLite readback/restart; no user browser/UI deployment.

gates.title: Informational impostor
gates.required_behavior: Replace functional page with approved-looking static prose; required behavior tests fail.
gates.remaining_boundary: A prose-only Python application impostor fails; no browser-page adapter tested.

gates.title: Fake-success and backend loss
gates.required_behavior: Hard-coded success or backend failure cannot pass integrated readiness; truthful error and persistence checks distinguish them.
gates.remaining_boundary: Hardcoded success and backend loss fail the real fixture oracle; not the user production application.

gates.title: Independent concurrency
gates.required_behavior: Two authorized disjoint workflow tasks progress and commit without overwriting each other or global-lease starvation.
gates.remaining_boundary: Independent local threads/processes/socket clients commit; not distributed controllers.

gates.title: Conflicting resource writes
gates.required_behavior: Conflicting file/interface/migration/environment acquisitions have one accepted authority; stale fence fails promotion.
gates.remaining_boundary: Local hierarchical resource fences and stale acceptance rejection; no enforced Git/deployment publisher.

gates.title: Concurrent source invalidation
gates.required_behavior: Change a source dependency while worker executes; its stale context/evidence is held at affected effect or promotion boundary.
gates.remaining_boundary: Registered sources/revisions and live candidate freshness are checked; no background filesystem watcher.

gates.title: Cross-repository observation
gates.required_behavior: Changing a registered producer revision invalidates affected consumer/integration readiness; unrelated work continues.
gates.remaining_boundary: Explicit producer revision invalidates candidate; no live cross-repository event-fabric integration.

gates.title: Cross-repository candidate vector
gates.required_behavior: Integration evidence identifies all assembled candidate revisions and actual contracts; mismatched vectors cannot close.
gates.remaining_boundary: Multiple repository inputs captured in one vector; not an assembled deployed multi-repo application.

gates.title: Partial integration recovery
gates.required_behavior: Interrupt between repository publication/deployment steps; state reflects partial result and authorized reconciliation, not whole-change success.
gates.remaining_boundary: Partial two-resource effect recovery tested, not interrupted Git publication/deployment across repos.

gates.title: Provider discovery and lifecycle
gates.required_behavior: Each enabled installed adapter proves identity entry, hydration, tool interception, actual compaction behavior where supported and enforced/cooperative classification.
gates.remaining_boundary: Shipped MCP stdio adapter lifecycle and tool gateway tested in subprocesses. Vendor-native tools and hidden compaction are not intercepted; actual Codex/Claude installations require target-host checks.

gates.title: Rate-limit handoff
gates.required_behavior: Exercise authorized provider interruption/rotation without deleting workflow identity or repeating uncertain effects; no reliance on final message.
gates.remaining_boundary: Manual worker rotation/release preserves job; no real provider rate-limit exercise.

gates.title: Process and stale worker recovery
gates.required_behavior: Expired lease does not imply process death; record process identity, reconcile result and reject stale shared promotion.
gates.remaining_boundary: Real SIGKILL plus stale ownership/process observations; no hostile surviving same-UID writer containment.

gates.title: Partition discipline
gates.required_behavior: When multi-host is enabled, lose connectivity and reconnect old worker; no split-brain promotion or independent writable-authority divergence.
gates.remaining_boundary: Opt-in mutual-TLS remote-worker transport to ONE authority; real loopback partition/lost-reply tests. Not a physical two-host or active-active controller certification.

gates.title: Privacy and export restore
gates.required_behavior: Scoped transfers do not leak credentials or unrelated memory; restore preserves evidence, lineage and one-authority rules.
gates.remaining_boundary: Scope checks, secret rejection and key-free backup tested; external one-authority enforcement needs operator fencing.

gates.title: Bounded hot-path performance
gates.required_behavior: Measure representative long histories and many workflows; heartbeat/commit validation stays incremental without losing integrity checks.
gates.remaining_boundary: Incremental hot-path tests and bounded contention samples; not huge-history or 24-hour endurance certification.

gates.title: Migration and final acceptance
gates.required_behavior: Versioned migration preserves original evidence and supports controlled rollback; all required behavioral gates have candidate-bound evidence and reviewed exceptions.
gates.remaining_boundary: Real 0.1.0/schema-1 staged migration and preactivation rollback tested with archived runtime; final acceptance rejects missing proof and requires explicit signed reviews. Earlier unidentified standalone-store migration remains unsupported.

gates.title: Exact source and diagnostic provenance
gates.required_behavior: Source and harness identities are checked before import or execution. The actual installed target is distinguished from the standalone audit subject.
gates.remaining_boundary: Package manifest preflight and installed module/source identity recorded; unsigned integrity is not publisher authentication.

gates.title: Patched storage and explicit durability preflight
gates.required_behavior: The linked SQLite library has a verified WAL-race fix; requested WAL, synchronous and foreign-key settings are read back.
gates.remaining_boundary: Known unpatched WAL rejected; actual run uses rollback fallback. Patched WAL library was not installed/exercised here.

gates.title: Connection lifecycle under failure
gates.required_behavior: Connections close on normal, rollback and initialization-failure paths without unbounded resource growth.
gates.remaining_boundary: Connections close on tested success/failure/rollback paths with ResourceWarnings promoted to errors; no long soak.

gates.title: Atomic preparation and artifact publication
gates.required_behavior: Domain event, projection updates and outbox are committed together; acknowledged artifact references resolve to durable bytes.
gates.remaining_boundary: Preparation/projections/outbox/blob references atomic in tested local transactions.

gates.title: Out-of-order and late authenticated receipts
gates.required_behavior: Receipts are deduplicated, cannot regress settled outcomes and remain observable after an old worker loses write authority.
gates.remaining_boundary: Duplicate/conflicting/late receipts handled with API authority; no external signed receipt adapter.

gates.title: Cancellation and authorization-change race
gates.required_behavior: Cancellation stops unsent work and reconciles sent work; it never claims that cancellation itself undid an external effect.
gates.remaining_boundary: Prepared-vs-sent cancellation and revocation tested; external operations cannot be retroactively undone.

gates.title: Deduplication expiry and ambiguous absence
gates.required_behavior: Retry is bounded by destination semantics, request hash and deduplication lifetime; eventual-consistency absence is not treated as proof.
gates.remaining_boundary: Ambiguous file absence and unknown commands hold safely; no destination idempotency-TTL adapter.

gates.title: Event replay and schema evolution
gates.required_behavior: Replay deterministically rebuilds projections without reexecuting model calls or effects; old event bytes remain immutable.
gates.remaining_boundary: Schema-1 event bytes preserved in schema-2 storage; deterministic replay tested. Unknown future versions fail closed.

gates.title: Backup restore cannot resurrect authority
gates.required_behavior: Restored authority starts recovery-only; a new nonrollback generation or trust key invalidates prior tickets at enforcing boundaries.
gates.remaining_boundary: Restore new local key/generation + recovery hold; external original-authority fencing is an operator attestation.

gates.title: Action-context freshness and actual delivery
gates.required_behavior: Preparation binds current dependencies and the actual input supplied for this invocation, not a reused acknowledgment.
gates.remaining_boundary: Actual serialized RPC context body is bound; hidden model prompts/compaction remain outside observation.

gates.title: Capability and information-boundary bypass
gates.required_behavior: Worker cannot bypass the declared gateway or elevation policy; sensitive reads and provider transfers are scoped effects.
gates.remaining_boundary: API scope checks only; same-UID code, filesystem/network and provider transfers are not sandboxed.

gates.title: Acceptance oracle and verifier integrity
gates.required_behavior: Execution receipts come from a protected runner; skipped, zero-collected, timed-out and weakened required tests cannot establish acceptance.
gates.remaining_boundary: Immutable registered real oracle rejects skips/zero/fail/timeouts; malicious same-UID code can bypass OS-level isolation.

gates.title: Fairness and bounded recovery scheduling
gates.required_behavior: Independent eligible work progresses under bounded resources while one task or provider is repeatedly blocked.
gates.remaining_boundary: Local least-attempted queue fairness/independent progress tested; no sustained provider budget SLA.

gates.title: Uninstrumented performance and scrub contract
gates.required_behavior: Timing samples exclude deliberately added history scans; optimization preserves declared corruption-detection bounds.
gates.remaining_boundary: Raw benchmark intervals avoid full scrub; startup/manual scrub exists, periodic enforcement is operational.

gates.title: Capture race and candidate completeness
gates.required_behavior: Candidate manifests describe actual immutable tested inputs, including required dirty/untracked/generated/environment data.
gates.remaining_boundary: Two stable full-source passes plus dirty/untracked/mode capture; not an atomic filesystem snapshot.

gates.title: Historical evidence and signed trust boundary
gates.required_behavior: Consistent hashes, historical tests, reference prototypes and installed-runtime proof remain distinct evidence classes.
gates.remaining_boundary: Installed/source/historical evidence separated with hashes; no external publisher signature/attestation.
